why_bad: Strong breach notice, liability cap, and exit return/delete — but open third-party sharing and indefinite retention. Isolates subprocessor + data_retention failures.

expected_findings.reason: Any affiliate/partner/third party, any purpose, no customer notice — open sharing gap.
Data kept for the life of a product program with no erase-when-no-longer-needed duty.

expected_no_flag.reason: 72-hour notice after confirmation is adequate for this first-pass check.
Explicit 12-month fees cap — should not flag.
Return or secure delete within 30 days with certification — should not flag.
Payment terms are unrelated to third-party sharing.
